amethyst.name: Amethyst Fragment
description: A piece of amethyst often found near the Gorge of Oz, the Gray Wolf Forest.
It is often used by locals to make jewelry or as a gift as a token of appreciation.
There seems to be a collector collecting pieces of amethyst.

special.name: Special Amethyst Fragment
description: A special amethyst fragment awarded as a reward for completing the Direction of Prayer Pass.
